subject: Dedicated pool scaling + model transition: capacity & term alignment
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@lumenretail.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Angela Park <angela.park@lumenretail.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Capacity ask: planning for 32k model + reranker in Q2

Hi Olga,

Quick update from our infra planning: our retrieval+rerank pipeline is moving to a larger 32k-context base model for Q2 (internal name: lumen-32k-gen). We expect a ~2.7x token/compute increase per request and need predictable throughput at peak (target: 1.2k concurrent users, 150 requests/sec sustained during peak windows).

Current Dedicated pool is H100x8 with burst; that's no longer sufficient if we add the reranker (which will be deployed as a separate service). Angela and I sketched a plan and attached a worksheet with estimated GPU-hours. Can we discuss adding a reserved pool (H100x16) and a short term to align the billing? We are also evaluating a 12-month term extension in exchange for a commitment credit.

High level asks:
- Dedicated reserved pool: additional H100x16 (or equivalent) available by 2027-04-01
- Throughput SLA: 99.5% for 95th percentile latency for text-gen routes (1s target for gen only; reranker 350ms)
- Pricing: proposal for commitment tier and burst pricing

Attaching capacity worksheet (lumen-capacity-plan-2027.xlsx) — it includes simulated token profiles.

Thanks — would love 30 min tomorrow to run numbers.

— Samir
Senior Engineering Manager, Lumen Retail

Subject: Re: Capacity ask: planning for 32k model + reranker in Q2

Samir — thanks for the detail and the worksheet. I read through the token sims; the projected tail behavior is the key driver here.

We can support the proposed H100x16 reserved pool but want to align on two things before committing:
1) Model mix & routing: can you confirm the percent split between long-context gen traffic vs reranker calls? The worksheet shows 30/70 but Angela mentioned it might flip.
2) Term & credits: we typically require a 12-month reserved commitment for new pool adds to qualify for capacity discounts; we can draft a term amendment that front-loads a one-time onboarding credit to offset initial provisioning costs.

Marissa (renewals) and Karthik (solutions) — looping you in to work up an initial pricing/throughput SLAs proposal and a quick SOW. Monica, can you plan a runbook for the reranker failover (fallback to smaller model) so Lumen can keep query rates during incidents?

I can take a 30-minute call tomorrow 10:30–11:30 PT. Put something on my calendar and we'll review the numbers.

Best,
Olga Petrov

Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity ask: planning for 32k model + reranker in Q2

Thanks — I pulled some baseline numbers from our telemetry and ran a quick estimate assuming Lumen's worksheet. Two configurations look reasonable:

Option A (throughput-prioritized):
- Add H100x16 reserved pool (dedicated) + keep existing H100x8 for burst
- Expected sustained throughput: ~220 reqs/sec across gen+ranks with ~1s gen latency, 320ms rerank
- Commitment: 12 months additional term on top of existing term; 8% unit discount

Option B (latency-prioritized + canary):
- Add H100x12 + enable cross-pool routing to a lower-cost quantized variant for non-peak traffic
- Sustained throughput: ~170 reqs/sec; 95th pctl latency within targets; additional headroom via burst credits
- Commitment: 12 months + 6% unit discount + one-time onboarding credit ($28k)

I'll attach a draft SOW and a redline-friendly term amendment (SOW attached as sow-proposed-term-amendment.pdf). Karthik, can you validate model sizing assumptions?

Samir/Angela — if you want guaranteed 150 reqs/sec for peak and the reranker to stay within 350ms 95th, Option A is the safer default; Option B is cheaper but needs the quantized fallback policy to hit peak economics.

— Marissa
Director, Renewals — Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@lumenretail.com>, Angela Park <angela.park@lumenretail.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity ask: planning for 32k model + reranker in Q2

Couple of technical clarifications from the sizing side:
- The 32k model (lumen-32k-gen) uses more KV cache per session; if Lumen expects long-lived persona sessions (avg KV 3.2k tokens retained) we'll need additional memory-optimized slices. That pushes the effective per-GPU throughput down ~18%.
- Reranker parallelism: we recommend running reranker replicas on a separate pool (dedicated CPU or smaller-quantized GPU family like A10x8) for cost efficiency — this reduces H100 consumption and keeps latency tighter for gen.

Given those, my recommended configuration (balanced):
- New pool: H100x12 for 32k gen deployments (memory-optimized layout)
- Separate reranker pool: A10x8 with reserved capacity for rerank throughput (expected 200 reqs/sec)
- Canary plan: route 15% of traffic to quantized 16k-equivalent variant while monitoring quality metrics for two weeks; automatic rollback if quality delta > 2% PQ score

I'll include a note about KV retention and estimated scaling factor in the SOW. Monica — I'll coordinate the runbook with you for fallback and live traffic split.

— Karthik
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Samir / Angela — nice sync this morning. Summary and next steps below (agree or flag edits):

Summary decisions:
- Provisioning: target go-live 2027-04-01 with a two-pool approach: H100x12 (memory-optimized) for 32k gen; A10x8 reserved for reranker.
- Term: 12-month amendment for the new pools, starting on activation date. Marissa proposed Option B economics with a one-time onboarding credit ($28k) to help with initial cost — Lumen preferred Option B in the call to preserve headroom.
- SLA: throughput guidance set to 150 reqs/sec guaranteed for peak window (gen+ranks combined) with 99.5% availability; per-route latency targets remain: gen 1s, rerank 350ms (95th).
- Canary: route 15% to quantized variant for two weeks; automatic rollback threshold set to 2% PQ score drop.

Action items:
- Marissa: finalize term amendment & updated quote (deliver by Tue 2027-02-22). Attach: sow-proposed-term-amendment.pdf.
- Karthik & Monica: deliver runbook & canary plan; include KV retention sizing note (due Wed 2027-02-24).
- Samir: procurement contact & PO timeline — confirm by Mon 2027-02-22.
- Olga: coordinate activation schedule with infra and submit provisioning ticket after PO.

Attachments referenced: lumen-capacity-plan-2027.xlsx, sow-proposed-term-amendment.pdf

If all that looks right, we'll route the amendment to procurement and attach the SOW. If you need alternate economics (higher discount for a 24-month commit), we can include that as an appendix.

Thanks again — look forward to getting this in place.

Best,
